But when Haakon VIII swore the oath of allegiance before parliament on September 1st, some splendour was in order. The new king arrived in the Lincoln Continental that his father, Harald V, used for his wedding in 1968. Dressed in uniform next to Ingrid Alexandra, the crown princess, Haakon vowed to have the same good relationship with parliament that his father did.
